config.analyzer: pdb.chinese_compatible with default filters; no external dictionary
config.query_mode: SELECT source_id, paradedb.score(source_id)::double precision AS score FROM candidate_sections WHERE source_id @@@ paradedb.match('index_text', $1, conjunction_mode=>false) ORDER BY score DESC, source_id COLLATE "C" ASC LIMIT 20
config.ranking: pg_search BM25; match tokenizer uses index configuration, disjunction mode, no fuzzy/prefix

measurements.environment: PostgreSQL17.8/vector0.8.1; nonce container 2CPU/3GiB; private Unix socket/psql; no timing samples; relation size excludes external extension files
